correctness.rationale: The cited edge-inflation wedge theorem establishes concentration in degree n-1; a complete proof from oriented regular CW cells, alternating Hopf trace, and exhaustive classification of unordered-pair orbit lengths yields the displayed joint character. In n=3, invariant edge chains vanish and alternating triangle-color tensors identify the quotient with the exterior cube. The standalone checker independently agrees on 170 signed character instances, eight complete mod-two cellular homology cases, and 41 quotient-character instances.

value.rationale: Complete character for S_n times S_q is a natural intrinsic topological symmetry invariant of the uniform multiclique posets central to edge inflation. The gcd/lcm product reduces exponentially many colored cells to subsets of permutation cycles and determines all rational irreducible multiplicities. The n=3 quotient has a concrete exterior-cube module and binomial top Betti number, invisible in scalar nonequivariant ranks; this is a meaningful quotient invariant without inventing downstream claims.
